cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've tapped my microphone like you. Before the school show, please tell everyone who made the costumes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I tapped mine because it wasn't working. You're tapping a torch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, checking the light as well. The costumes need to be seen, and I'd like my name heard.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll say it on the working microphone. You can stay by the lighting desk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, that's my position. Say my name, then point me out before I move any of these switches.
